avis.titre: A Rare Skincare Product That Impressed MeA Rare Skincare Product That Impressed Me
avis.texte: I have tried more skin care products than I can count, and more often than not they tend to be a huge letdown. Because of that, I keep my expectations low. I am a woman of a certain age and am currently dealing with dull and dry-looking skin, while a recent history of acne is thankfully mostly behind me. The first thing I noticed that I like about this exfoliating product is the wide-mouth jar with a stack of pads. I don't have to meter out the product, I don't have to purchase separate cotton balls or pads, and I don't have to fight with the container to get the product out. The next thing I noticed is that the pads are slightly abrasive. The last thing I noticed is that my skin felt noticeably softer and smoother immediately after use. I rarely find a product where I notice a difference right away, so that alone makes this product stand out to me. At the listed price of $38.00, this is a bit of an investment, but if it is within your budget, it may be worthwhile if you are in the market for a premium exfoliating facial product. Personally, I am using it 2–3 times a week, so I expect the 60 pads to last me roughly 5–7 months.

This is my first impression of the DRMTLGY brand and count me as impressed! I am in my 40s and dull skin seems to be my forte as of late. I have tried several different brands of exfoliating pads, some I like, and was interested in trying DRMTLGY FacialRX Daily Peel Pads. These claim both AHA and BHA exfoliation to visibly smooth lines and textures, minimize the look of pores, reduce dullness, and brighten appearance while reducing the look of dark marks. The pads have a dual sized texture and depending on skin type can be used 1-3 times a week. They are cruelty free, sulfate free, paraben free and fragrance free. I like that these come in a twist top container to seal in moisture. They are pre-moistened with product, as most exfoliating ads are. The pads have a slightly abrasive side, helping with exfoliation, and smooth side to finish. My skin felt clean, refreshed, and so smooth. I especially noticed a difference in smoothness on my neck. I had no severe redness, rash, or other adverse effects. The formula was effective without being too harsh on my skin. I look forward to seeing what the results are after a months' worth of use is. At around $40 this is an affordable product that is worth it.

avis.titre: One of My New Favorite DRMTLGY Products!One of My New Favorite DRMTLGY Products!
avis.texte: I’m a big fan of DRMTLGY products and have several of them in my skincare routine. I’ve honestly never been disappointed with the brand, and these FacialRX Daily Peel Pads have quickly become one of my new favorites. I’ve been using them for about 2 weeks, and I can already see a noticeable difference in my skin. My skin looks brighter, smoother, and more refreshed, and I feel like my overall skin texture has improved. My complexion also looks more even and less dull. I love how convenient these are. The pads are already saturated with product, so there’s no mixing or mess, and they make exfoliating incredibly easy. The combination of glycolic acid, lactic acid, and salicylic acid gives me the exfoliation I’m looking for without having to use a harsh scrub. I also like that they help with the appearance of pores and leave my skin feeling clean and smooth. They’re an easy addition to my routine and perfect for when I want a little extra exfoliation without adding another complicated step. Another great DRMTLGY product that has definitely earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine. I’m very impressed with the results after only two weeks and highly recommend these!

I started using these pads a few nights a week after washing my face, and I've been pretty happy with the results. The pads come pre-soaked so there's no mixing or measuring anything - just wipe and go, which is great for my nighttime routine when I'm already tired and just want something simple. My skin texture has noticeably smoothed out, especially around my nose and chin where I tend to get some rough patches and clogged pores. The tingle is mild, not harsh like some other acid products I've tried, so I don't get that red irritated look afterward. I do notice my skin looking a bit brighter overall, though I wouldn't say it's a dramatic transformation - more of a gradual improvement. One thing to note is that the pads are on the thinner side, so you have to be careful not to tear them when pulling them out of the jar. Also, the container isn't the most travel-friendly since it's a wide jar rather than something compact. For the count you get, I think it's a solid value since a little goes a long way with each pad. I'd recommend these if you want an easy, low-effort way to add exfoliation into your routine without the hassle of separate toners or serums.
It’s a peel… wouldn’t use it daily.. a bit strong but very effective. Good job, thanks for making it.

I like the convenience of these peel pads. Everything is already measured onto an individual pad, so there is no guessing how much product to use or dealing with another bottle and cotton pads. The combination of glycolic, lactic, and salicylic acids gives you both AHA and BHA exfoliation in one product. After using them, my skin feels smoother and refreshed, and I like having them as part of a simple skincare routine. Despite the "Daily" name, I wouldn't automatically assume everyone needs to use these every day. This is a combination of several exfoliating acids, so I started slowly to see how my skin reacted rather than immediately using them seven days a week. The 60-count container is convenient and should last a while depending on how frequently you use them. Overall, I like the formula and especially the simplicity of the pre-soaked pads. Just don't assume that more exfoliation automatically means better results.

avis.titre: THIS is the kind of exfoliating formula I like to seeTHIS is the kind of exfoliating formula I like to see
avis.texte: I realy like how much thought DRMTLGY put into the acid blend in these peel pads instead of relying on one exfoliating ingredient and calling it a day. I am very interested in exfoliation, but I also pay attention to what a formula is doing around those exfoliating acids because I don't want skincare to be entirely about aggressively stripping away the surface of the skin. These come with 60 pre-soaked peel pads, and the current DRMTLGY formula uses what the brand calls its 4X Smart Acid System. That includes 5% mandelic acid, 2% lactic acid, 2% succinic acid and 2% salicylic acid. So you are getting several different types of acids working in different ways rather than one incredibly high percentage of a single exfoliant. I especially like seeing mandelic and lactic acids here. Those are both AHAs, while salicylic acid is a BHA that can work down into oily congestion in pores. DRMTLGY specifically uses the 2% salicylic acid for pore congestion and the appearance of enlarged pores, while the mandelic acid is positioned more toward dullness and discoloration. Then you have lactic acid working on surface texture.

Derma Exfoliating Peel Pads Review These Derma exfoliating peel pads offer a solid balance of effective exfoliation and gentle performance. While they lean a little on the pricey side, that is typically what you expect to pay for a product from a reputable beauty company. Visually and physically, the container is a practical size, and the individual pads are easy to grab and separate without creating a mess. Functionally, these seem to exfoliate the skin very well, leaving it noticeably softer and smoother after each use. Pacing usage to 1–3 times a week hits the sweet spot for keeping skin clear and smooth; using them on a daily basis could easily lead to unnecessary irritation. Overall, for the price point, they deliver dependable quality and great skin-smoothing results.

Gentle enough for my eczema prone skin, as long as I use it every third day. That’s about as often as I can tolerate AHA and BHA exfoliation. The only other product my skin hasn’t had a reaction to is PC. I started slow with this…I have ultra sensitive skin…with once a week, then twice a week. I’m now able to use it 3x a week. I always follow it with a richly hydrating cream (with no other actives), and only use it in my PM routine. I haven’t been using it long enough to see any long term benefits or effects, but since my sensitive skin can tolerate it, I’m going to continuing it for sure. You get 60 pads, so for me, using it 3x a week, it’s a good value to have consistent and gentle exfoliation.

avis.titre: Beware if you have sensitive skin..
avis.texte: I usually like DRMTLGY products and have recently started on my journey of removing texture from my face. I had been using glycolic acid by manually pouring it onto pads, but these looked like a more convenient way to make even more progress. My skin hasn't gotten used to the exfoliating acids yet and I have sensitive skin, so it kind of feels like a razor blade going across my skin- not a great feeling. Even worse if I use it on my neck and I almost immediately get red irritation bumps. I tried this out for a while and the irritation bumps got worse. I have a ton of small bumps all over my skin now, even though I followed up usage with a calming moisturizer and didn't combine with any other acids. Ultimately, I had to stop using these.

I’ve used the Drmtlgy tinted moisturizer so I was intrigued by these daily peel pads. Users should note that they can only be used daily by oily/combination skin but users with dry/normal skin should only use them a couple times a week per the instructions. I do notice that my skin feels dry almost immediately after using them, but I have also noticed a difference in the appearance of my skin and my face does look better after I use these pads. I would recommend these peel pads to anybody looking to improve clarity in their skin.

DRMTLGY is a well known brand and my wife uses a few of their products already so she was excited to try these. This particular container includes 60 pads. The directions indicate depending on your skin condition, is how often you should use them. My wife is using them every night after washing her face. There is a bit of tingling but not nearly as much as other products. The pads are easy to use and go on smoothly. She has noticed that some of the rough areas on her face are slowly becoming more smooth since she started applying these a few weeks ago. She is excited to see the results after 2 months. As with many of the other DRMTLGY products, these daily peel pads are with the same high quality standards. Would definitely recommend and at a reasonable cost.

avis.titre: DRMTLGY FacialRX Daily Peel Pads 60 Count | Exfoliating Facial Pads | AHA + BHA exfoliation
avis.texte: I've used the DRMTLGY Tingl exfoliating pads for several years but they're too strong now for my skin since switching to tret, so when I heard the brand was launching a more gentle peel pad I was ready to try it. The new FacialRX peel pads give the multi-acid goodness and are effective, but more gentle than the Tingl pads. You still feel that "tingle" in your skin after use, and my texture is soft and glassy the next few day. The pads have the traditional waffle texture but aren't scratchy. No scent that I noticed. You get peptides, arginene, humectants...I use one pad and apply to face, ears, and neck (and underarms!), let it dry down for about 15 minutes, then follow with a nourishing serum and a dab of moisturizer and my skin feels amazing. Instructions are that those with oily or combo skin can use daily, normal to dry should stick with several times a week. They are more gentle, but still give a potent exfoliation. No irritation for my tret skin with these.

I’ve become a big fan of DRMTLGY products, and these peel pads are another great addition to my skincare routine. They’re fragrance-free, which I really appreciate, and they leave my skin feeling smoother and looking brighter without being overly harsh. The quality is excellent, and I’ve consistently had great results with this brand. My only complaint is the price, they’re definitely on the pricier side. That said, if you’re willing to invest in quality skincare, I think they’re worth considering. They’ve worked wonders for my skin, and I’ll continue purchasing DRMTLGY products.

avis.titre: Easy Addition to My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: These peel pads are super easy to use and have just the right amount of product on them. The pads have a nice textured surface, so I feel like I’m getting some gentle exfoliation without having to scrub my face. They do give me a little tingle when I use them, but nothing uncomfortable. My skin feels really smooth and clean afterward, and I like that it’s just one quick step. The container also comes with 60 pads, which is a pretty generous amount.

avis.titre: Good peel pads from a great brand
avis.texte: I really like this brand and have had good experiences with their products. These peel pads are nice and saturated with plenty of product on each pad. They do have a slightly weird smell, but I actually prefer that over a strong added fragrance. The formula feels pretty strong, so I would use them sparingly on the face, especially if you have sensitive skin like I do or use retinoids. I also like using them on areas like my knees and elbows where I want some extra exfoliation. Overall, a good peel pad that feels effective and lasts a while. DRMTLGY FacialRX Daily Peel Pads 60 Count | AHA + BHA Exfoliation with Glycolic Acid, Lactic Acid & Salicylic Acid

These exfoliating pads are the real deal, they really make your skin feel nice and clean without feeling like you scrubbed a layer of skin off. I have sensitive skin and these give me no issues. I only use them 2-3x a week as instructed for my skin type so I don’t over do it and irritate it.

avis.titre: I Love These Daily Peel Pads!
avis.texte: These daily peel pads are hands down the very best! The quality is good and they work great! The packaging is totally on point and it's a piece of cake to use! I really like that the pack contains 60 pads that are pre soaked! I think it's great that they remove dead skin cells, unclog pores, and promote smoother more radiant looking skin without harsh scrubbing! Plus they help brighten the appearance of post blemish marks and minimize the look of pores too! Overall I give this product two great big thumbs way up and would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: An Easy Way to Smoother, Brighter Skin
avis.texte: These peel pads are a simple addition to my skincare routine and leave my skin feeling smoother and looking more refreshed without the mess of liquid exfoliants. I use one pad in the evening a few times a week after cleansing, followed by a moisturizer, and I've noticed my skin looks brighter, feels softer, and my pores appear a little more refined over time. They contain glycolic, lactic, and salicylic acids, so they're effective but can be a bit much for very sensitive skin or those new to chemical exfoliants—it’s best to start slowly and adjust frequency based on your skin’s tolerance. They layer well with hydrating serums and moisturizers, though I avoid using them in the same routine as other strong exfoliants or retinoids to help minimize irritation. With regular use, you can expect smoother texture, improved clarity, reduced dullness, and a more even-looking complexion. Overall, these are convenient, effective exfoliating pads that make maintaining healthy-looking skin quick and easy.
